name: AI Reel Maker
headline: Make *animated reels* with Claude Code
summary: One line in, a finished animated reel out: script, voiceover, motion graphics, word-timed captions and a self-check of every frame.

items.title: Get the Claude desktop app
items.text: Skip the browser. Download it from claude.ai/download and sign in. Claude Code needs a paid plan (Pro or higher).

items.title: Download the kit and unzip it
items.text: You get a folder called AI Video Editor. Put it on your Desktop. Your skill files and every finished reel live here.

items.title: Start a Claude Code chat on that folder
items.text: Code tab → new session → choose Local → select the AI Video Editor folder.

items.title: Type `check my setup`
items.text: Claude installs what's missing inside the folder (no password) and tests itself on a sample reel. Click Allow when it asks. About 10 minutes the first time.

items.title: Type what the reel is about, in one line
items.text: For example: `make a reel about why airplane food tastes so bland`. It writes the script, records the voiceover, animates every scene, times the captions and checks its own frames.

items.title: Tell it what to change
items.text: Like you would a video editor. Every change saves a new version. See the fix lines.

sections.title: The *prompts*
sections.intro: Type these in the Claude Code chat inside the AI Video Editor folder.

items.title: Check my setup
items.text: Check my setup. Install anything that's missing inside this folder, then test it by rendering the sample reel. Tell me in plain words when it's ready.

items.title: Make a reel from one line
items.text: Make a reel about [[your topic in one line]]. About [[30]] seconds. End with: [[Follow for more / Comment KEYWORD and I'll send you ...]]

items.title: Use your own voice (optional)
items.text: Use my recording for the voice: [[drag your audio file here]]. Match the script to what I said, then re-time the captions and render again.

sections.title: Fix *lines*
items: The third scene feels empty, show the numbers.
Add a comment keyword at the end: GUIDE.
sections.tip: Every change saves a new version (v2, v3...), so you never lose one.

sections.title: What it *does*

features.title: Records the voice
features.text: Free voice on your computer, or your own
